question: Who was appointed as the Chairman of National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (NaBFID) in October 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**KV Kamath**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **KV Kamath** was appointed as the Chairman of the National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (NaBFID) in October 2021.
 
• NaBFID is a newly established development financial institution (DFI) aimed at addressing the infrastructure financing needs of the country.
 
• KV Kamath is a well-known figure in the banking and financial sector, having previously served as the CEO and Managing Director of ICICI Bank.
 
• He has also played a significant role in the development of financial institutions in India and has held various prestigious positions, including the President of the New Development Bank (NDB) set up by BRICS nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• NaBFID was established in 2021 under the National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development Act, 2021.
 
• The institution aims to catalyze investment in the infrastructure sector, which is crucial for the economic development of India.
 
• It will provide long-term finance for infrastructure projects, which typically have long gestation periods and require substantial capital.
 
• The establishment of NaBFID is part of the Indian government's broader strategy to boost infrastructure development and attract private sector investment.
 
• KV Kamath's appointment is expected to bring valuable expertise and leadership to the institution, given his extensive experience in the financial sector.
